product_masters.note: Same product_id space, different attributes and coverage. Current single-source discovery models them as three separate classes and does not merge them; only the first product-named table in folder order receives product_id edges.

notes.determinism: Fixed seed, per-table RNG from the table name, fixed date range 2024-01-01..2024-12-31, no clock and no absolute paths in the output.
notes.ground_truth_derivation: class and expected_relations are derived by replaying the CURRENT naming rules (ontology.discover) on the same table/column shapes; regenerating is required if those rules change.
notes.orphans: A few foreign-key rows hold 9001/9002 on purpose, so rows pointing at nothing are exercised.
notes.formats: connect() reads one folder level; all 100 files are directly in the folder.
